name: Ray Gunner
body:
Your magical attacks are effective at greater distance.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 1+.

Benefit(s): Your ray attack spells have 50% more range than normal. If other effects increase the range of your ray spells (like the Enlarge Spell or Reach Spell metamagic feats), apply the benefits of this feat after all other modifiers to the spell’s range.
